summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that the European Patent Office completed technical preparations for publication of its European patent application covering its Trap & Target mucoadhesive polymer technology platform for nasal drug delivery. The application, published under number EP 4751737, covers intranasal hydrogels intended to improve formulation retention and drug absorption. This is a routine intellectual property milestone announcement by a development-stage biotech company. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer is present. The filing is an ordinary update on patent prosecution, not a corporate event requiring classification.
